findings.claim: UPHELD. At a58ecf7bc9a085f9018d24027f323553fa0d1432, ordinary `conduct codex dev` has no named first host-bootstrap entrypoint. Owner admission in lane-policy.md:708-725 is a durable decision and does not require a running conductor; trust establishment is not circular. FD 3-8 production is assigned only to the role "admitted parent"; ops/bin/conduct is specified only as preserver and is absent. mint_id exists at launch.py:111; bind_launch, prepare_conductor and compile_launch remain declared APIs without definitions. Smallest ownership remedy, no new executor/store: assign host-bootstrap to the conduct frontend under the existing canonical launch owner, in order acquire already-admitted custody, resolve selection/declarations, call mint_id once, derive bind_launch, then supply FD 3-8. Preserve `conduct codex dev` and the existing mint_id, bind_launch, prepare_conductor, compile_launch and launch.py APIs.
